Sharpe annualization comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: On the SAME contiguous UTC daily return series including weekends, Sharpe252=Sharpe365*sqrt(252/365). Confidence interval endpoints receive the same positive scale; no bootstrap, return, risk, rank, correlation, t-statistic, alpha, CAGR or selection is recomputed. Approximate flags explicitly mark252 values derived only from rounded current365 displays.

evidenceFlow.title: Deterministic display scaling only
evidenceFlow.detail: Read the exact source rows and any listed full-precision companion CSV; multiply only the explicitly declared numeric Sharpe statistics or Sharpe CI endpoints by sqrt(252/365). Keep all original fields unmodified; do not resample or drop weekends.

limitations: 252 is an alternative annualization convention, not a252-trading-day subsample or an independent result.
Existing primary inference, risk limits, and365-day scientific outputs remain unchanged.

methods.code: For declared Sharpe fields, write sharpe365_<field>=original fullprecision statistic and sharpe252_<field>=statistic*sqrt(252/365). Scale CI endpoints identically. For current group medians only, retain the original rounded365 display and flag252 as approximate. Counts, ranks and correlations are not scaling targets.
